summary: Rewrote the heuristic-search family page and all fifteen of its approach pages for the research console, following the four-altitude approach-page template. The family page approaches/heuristic-search/README.mdx now carries five engine-verified BoardCompare figures generated from a scripted 0x5eed-domain latent game through src/core/typescript/engine.ts, showing what 'open the board', 'prepare useful chains' and the height-versus-points tradeoff mean on real positions. The approach pages (critical-risk, cycle-abstraction, edge-priority, evolution, evolved-public-policy, exact-search, gray-throughput, open-loop, phase-horizon, policy-comparison, risk-sensitive, rollout, sparse-expectimax, tunneling, virtual-ignition) quote only numbers that exist in a retained record, carry the status/evidence labels from the experiment index and ledger, flag every historical 7,000-point Sequence-scored figure, state 'no retained result' where the record is empty, and note that the gray-throughput policy reads level and moves-played in its chance salt. No research record, source file, or protocol was modified.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
